title: Canonical evidence for generated artifact refresh

phases.objective: Publish one bounded canonical report for generated-artifact reconciliation and preserve the exact relationship between the triggering PR head and any generated commit that becomes the new PR head.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: PR Generated Artifact Refresh on an internal gpt/* or cert/* pull request
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow uploads a machine-readable exact-head decision and the trusted workflow_run publisher updates the authoritative PR comment without requiring Job-log reconstruction.
steps: Checkout the exact source PR head and record it as source_head_sha.
Generate and verify only the bounded artifact write set.
Refuse to push when the remote PR head moved after checkout.
Record the generated commit as candidate_sha when a commit is published, otherwise retain the source head as candidate_sha.
Upload the canonical JSON and Markdown report before enforcing its decision.
Validate the source-to-generated-head transition against the current PR before updating the canonical evidence comment.
assertions: The report always declares secrets_included=false and bounded redacted diagnostics.
A generated commit must equal candidate_sha while source_head_sha remains the workflow trigger identity.
A no-change run must use the source head as candidate_sha.
The publisher rejects stale, substituted, mismatched, closed-unmerged, or ambiguous PR identities.
Job logs remain diagnostic-only and never override the canonical report.

phases.objective: Add aggregate reporting for all remaining governed writer workflows that do not yet publish canonical evidence.
Exercise artifact-download failure, stale-head races, malformed reports, and publisher retry behavior without consulting Job logs for the workflow decision.
Observe the canonical section on representative generated-artifact PRs before making it a required branch-protection signal.
Require exact generated-artifact canonical evidence for protected-branch merge readiness.
